treatments.name: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (Paclitaxel weekly + Carboplatin followed by AC)

control: Partial response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy; PET‑CT (2025-06-20) shows decreased SUV of the left breast lesion and residual moderate axillary uptake, no distant metastases; levothyroxine 100 mcg daily for hypothyroidism; scheduled for left breast‑conserving surgery with SLNB and axillary dissection; next follow‑up appointment on 2025-12-01 to define adjuvant radiotherapy and possible pembrolizumab.
